instruction.text: Choose the correct verbs to finish the sentence in the present perfect form.

hint.text: The present perfect form is used for events that have happened recently or are still happening now. It is formed with has/have + main past form verb.
hint.sound: The present perfect form is used for events that have happened recently or are still happening now. It is formed with 'has' or 'have' plus the main past form verb.

atoms.b: I ((had_been ++have_been am)) saving up my pocket money recently.
Henry ((++has_played had_played played)) guitar for a year.
Laura ((++has_been had_been has)) off school with a cold this week.
Patrick ((++has_completed had_completed completed)) his first aid course.

instruction.text: Choose the correct verbs to finish the sentence in the past perfect form.

hint.text: The past perfect form is used for events that have happened before something else, and is formed with had + main past form verb.
hint.sound: The past perfect form is used for events that have happened before something else, and is formed with 'had' plus the main past form verb.

atoms.b: I ((++had_learnt have_learnt learnt)) Spanish before I visited Mexico.
Kyle ((++had_visited has_visited visits)) his new school before he started last week.
The Murphy’s ((++had_celebrated have_celebrated celebration)) their anniversary together last week.
Tilly ((++had_swum has_swum swum)) 50 lengths before her swimming lesson even began this morning.
